focus: Observable Plot marks, width/margins, invalid values, pointer tips, and legends
noveltyJustification: Current Plot 0.6.17 docs confirm the cited defaults and behaviors; the corpus matches static and null-handling outcomes, has no runtime interaction layer by contract, and still lacks the exact SVG gradient requested by T8.
keyQuestions: What Observable Plot defaults and interaction behaviors are current?
Which of those capabilities are present in the pinned corpus?
answeredQuestions: Plot treats marks as its visual vocabulary and recommends mark choice by data shape.
Plot defaults to 640px width, max-width 100%, and does not auto-adjust margins for long labels.
Invalid line values create breaks rather than interpolation.
tip:true derives a pointer-driven tip mark.
legend:true produces swatches for ordinal scales and smooth ramps for continuous scales; the corpus has only a static stepped/text ramp.
ruledOutDirections: Treating Plot's runtime legend as a shipped dependency.
